evidence.quote: In accordance with the special resolution passed by the shareholders and upon completion of the necessary formalities, the shares reflecting the sub-division of face value from Rs. 10/- to Rs. 2/- have been credited, as of the close of business on May 31, 2025, into the respective accounts of entitled shareholders maintained with the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited.

tax_withholding_note: Gross bonus adjustment only; shares withheld for tax are not portfolio credits.
